summary_en: RECOMM will acquire the remaining 49% stake in subsidiary RECOMM IE Partner through a simplified stock exchange, issuing 920,188 treasury shares valued at 88 yen per share. The acquisition follows RECOMM IE Partner's self-acquisition of 53 shares from Hikaritsuushin, reducing Hikaritsuushin's holding to 45 shares. The stock exchange is scheduled to become effective November 9, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Full Subsidiary Status of RECOMM IE Partner Co., Ltd. through Stock Exchange (Simplified Stock Exchange)
translation_en_brief:
RECOMM announced on October 19, 2026 that its board has approved a simplified stock exchange to acquire full ownership of subsidiary RECOMM IE Partner Co., Ltd. (RIE), currently 51% owned by RECOMM and 49% by Hikaritsuushin. RECOMM will issue 920,188 treasury shares at a reference price of 88 yen per share to acquire Hikaritsuushin's remaining stake. As a preparatory step, RIE itself will acquire 53 shares from Hikaritsuushin on October 26, 2026 and cancel them, reducing Hikaritsuushin's holding to 45 shares—the shares to be exchanged for RECOMM's stock.

The reference price of 88 yen is the simple average closing price of RECOMM's ordinary shares for the three months ending October 16, 2026. No new shares will be issued; RECOMM will use treasury shares to complete the acquisition. The stock exchange is scheduled to become effective on November 9, 2026. As a simplified stock exchange under the Companies Act, RECOMM shareholder approval is not required unless a specified number of shareholders file objections.

RECOMM identified three strategic benefits: streamlining decision-making by eliminating the joint venture structure; expanding cross-selling and group synergies by integrating RIE's environmental products (LED lighting, commercial air conditioning, new power services) with RECOMM's corporate customer base and sales network; and enhancing enterprise value by consolidating RIE's non-controlling interest and revenue into RECOMM's consolidated results. RIE was established in May 2016 as a joint venture to sell energy-efficient and environmental products and provide new power services as part of RECOMM's domestic solutions segment.
